newsitem.title: USA: Harvey, Universal plan Casper movie sequel.
newsitem.headline: Harvey, Universal plan Casper movie sequel.

text.p: Harvey Entertainment Co, Universal Pictures and Steven Spielberg's Amblin Entertainment have agreed to develop a sequel to the 1995 movie "Casper," Harvey said on Monday.
Financial details of the agreement were not disclosed.

Under the deal, the merchandising rights to the movie will be controlled by Universal, the film entertainment wing of Seagram Co Ltd. Merchandising rights to the character Casper, a ghost, are controlled by Harvey. Rights to Harvey's library of characters, including Baby Huey, Richie Rich and Wendy the Good Little Witch, revert to Harvey.
Harvey said it would work with Universal to develop Casper over the coming years.
The first Casper film, starring Christina Ricci, Bill Pullman and Cathy Moriarty, has earned more than $307 million worldwide since opening in May 1995.
